name: Jeong Na-yoon
source:
A small and petite girl who's always making mistakes. 
I can't help but pay attention to her.
Is it because she seems so fragile?
Or is it because something about her feels familiar...like a reflection of myself?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047680/Secret_Some/]Steam[/url]]
